notes.title: Version 0.1.4.2 Demo Update Note
notes.notes:
Welcome to Feastopia! Lately we've deployed the following updates to the demo:


[olist]
The default priority for buildings during Auto-Assignment is now set to 4.

Added tracking functionality and a dedicated panel for Mission and the Wishlist.

Adjusted the random weighting for Blueprint acquisition.

Optimized text descriptions for various in-game effects.

Fixed an issue caused by drag-and-drop operations on Gathering-type buildings.

Fixed a bug that prevented players from completing missions in the beginner's guide.

Optimized the English display in the beginner's guide.
[/olist]


Join our community!

We crave your feedback – share bugs, ideas, or culinary fantasies in the Feastopia Discord!

notes.title: Version 0.1.3.4 Demo Update Note
notes.notes:
Welcome to Feastopia! Lately we've deployed the following updates to the demo:


[olist]
Fixed a flickering issue with the pause button for resource supply in the Market.

Fixed display issues with resource count statistics.

Adjusted values for residents' food consumption.

Improved visual feedback for natural resources when placing Gathering Huts and Mines.

Added detailed tooltips to the Total Population display.

Reworked delivery logic and rewards for Population Reward Quests.

Adjusted completion logic and rewards for Exploration Events.

Reduced the resource cost to clear Fog of War.

Fixed incorrect text descriptions after completing certain quests.

Corrected erroneous reward values for Exploration Events.

Adjusted rewards for the Wishlist.

Optimized English translations and display effects across multiple UI elements.

Improved descriptions for various effect and button tooltips.

Tweaked effects and related values in the Land of Wish.

Adjusted the Atmosphere Gauge impact of various buildings.

Changed the starting quantities of the 3 Selectable Resources in the beginner setup.

Slightly tweaked the distribution weighting of natural resource nodes.

Reworked the base scoring of all resources; all resources now contribute to a category score.

Gathering Huts, Mines, Orchard Groves, and the Merchant Guildhall are now available as starting buildings.

Adjusted the consumption rate of resources required to maintain population. Upgrading dwellings will now slightly increase the consumption rate of lower-tier resources.

Adjusted the quality tiers of certain foods.

Temporarily removed Gold Bar, Paint, Rubber, Sheep Intestines, Alcohol, Poison Potion, Stationery, and Lavender from the game. Related production recipes, items, and facility functions have been redesigned.

Adjusted the acquisition logic for Blueprints.

Adjusted the acquisition logic for Recipes.

Adjusted the distribution weighting of Exploration Events.
[/olist]

PS: Due to the significant changes in this update, save data from previous versions is no longer compatible. Please start a new game.


Join our community!

We crave your feedback – share bugs, ideas, or culinary fantasies in the Feastopia Discord!

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.2 Demo Update Note
notes.notes:
Welcome to Feastopia! Lately we've deployed the following updates to the demo:


[olist]
Added population buffer mechanics: Population now gradually decreases over time when resources are insufficient (instead of instantly dropping to the target value).

Optimized auto-assignment logic: Workers are now prioritarily reallocated from lower-priority buildings.

Adjusted acquisition logic for Blueprints and Recipes.

Reworked food quality requirements for Dango’s feeding phases – now scales with growth stage.

Fixed animation layering issues where effect visuals persisted behind UI elements.

Fixed repeated appearance of identical Merchant Guildhall items in selection pools.

Reduced resource consumption when processing corpses at the Cemetery.

Lowered resource costs for clearing Fog.

Adjusted workforce tier requirements for population rewards.

Fixed incorrect effect triggers on specific items.
[/olist]


Join our community!

We crave your feedback – share bugs, ideas, or culinary fantasies in the Feastopia Discord!

notes.title: Version 0.1.1.1 Demo Update Note
notes.notes:
Welcome to Feastopia! Over the past three days since launch, we've deployed the following updates to the demo:


[olist]
Optimized numeric display effects in the settings interface.

Enhanced visual presentation of the "Atmosphere" value on certain UI elements.

Improved quantity display logic for hospitals and cemeteries: now shown as Current Processing Count / Maximum Treatment Capacity (or Body Handling Capacity).

Fixed issues related to Blueprint drawing mechanics.

Resolved a bug limiting the maximum constructible Merchant Guilds. The cap will now scale up with Dango's growth stage.
[/olist]


Join our community!

We crave your feedback – share bugs, ideas, or culinary fantasies in the Feastopia Discord!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.6 update log.
notes.notes:
Huge thanks to everyone who jumped into the Feastopia playtest! Your feedback means the world to us, and we’re hard at work making the game even more awesome based on what you’ve shared. During this playtest, we’ve been squashing bugs and tackling the most urgent stuff. Here’s what we’ve polished up and fixed in the latest update:

Tweaked how icons look for attached buildings

Made the fire station a starting building by default

Boosted the odds of getting blueprints for buildings tied to common materials for construction

Fixed a glitch where the livestock ranch blueprint wasn’t displaying right

Added clearer explanations for atmosphere debuff rules

Sorted out some icon text mix-ups

Fixed bugs with certain wishlist tasks showing incorrectly

Added helpful prompts when you’re about to build something

Resized attached buildings for the fisheries cabin

Fixed an issue where upgrading houses would spit back materials

Cleared up mistakes in food labels

Stopped blueprints from popping up more than once

Fixed mismatched beverages, icons, and fonts in the gourmet house

Now you can hit Esc to cancel pre-building, and hit it again to close the build menu

Tweaked how some blueprints unlock

Bumped up the resources needed to clear fog just a bit

Added a cool glow to icons for all attached buildings

Made the gourmet recipe UI look slicker

Increased the odds of getting blueprints for buildings that produce construction materials

Increased the common materials for construction needed for some basic buildings

Fixed a screen flash when opening the new level interface after the tutorial

Stopped the camera from going rogue when opening the wishlist while moving

Fixed the spacebar not pausing/resuming during road-building, demolish, repair, or move modes

Made sure the build menu updates resources in real-time so clicks work properly

Fixed an issue where the game would freeze and become unresponsive after Dango finished eating

Stopped Missions of the Cat God from resetting when you reload a save

Fixed data errors for Missions of the Cat God

Sorted out save file loading issues during lag

Fixed incorrect star rating color display on the top-right corner of food items

Cleaned up UI glitches after loading

Disabled blueprint refresh and “think again” button in the tutorial

Extended the max view distance

Added more wish fruits as a reward for clearing levels

Unified text for cucumbers and attached buildings across the game

All buildings that make materials for construction can now get blueprints at difficulty 1

Fixed icons not following attached buildings when you move them

Corrected info-display of Missions of the Cat God in the top-right corner

Fixed some cases where saves wouldn’t load

Stopped atmosphere debuff from bouncing around unexpectedly

Added Q/E keys for quick field-of-view changes

Set default volume (master, music, sound effects) to a comfy 50%

Game now auto-picks your system’s language

Beefed up the tutorial map to a 100x100 grid

Added smooth edge-of-screen mouse movement

Fixed the help bar getting cut off at certain resolutions

Added clear rules for picking starting buffs in the UI

Buildings go semi-transparent when you’re in demolish mode

Buildings that pause production now give super clear “on hold” notices

Thanks again for your support!
